scope.research_boundary: Use the same user-authorized evidence-only Luna agent; root remains sole writer. For each exact model, inspect all candidate/platform/source records plus relevant research attempts and extended-campaign history before lookup. Use one distinct web query per model and open at most one genuinely new product or technical source page. Before any page open, literal-search its final URL across repository data/ and docs/; if it is present or absence cannot be proven, do not open it.
field_rules: Complete weight must be attributable to the exact complete-bike build and retain size, included equipment and weighing basis; do not transfer regional or sibling-build weights.
Tire clearance requires an exact-model manufacturer maximum or another credible source that directly states maximum clearance; fitted-tire width alone is not a maximum.
For XDS GT350 and GT600, preserve exact model-year/trim ambiguity and do not infer a shared frame maximum without source evidence.
excluded: No agent edits; no XHS/Weibo, personal browser, login/CAPTCHA, seller outreach, external messages, quote submission, cart, checkout or purchase.
No image download, rehosting or change; no data changes outside the eleven frozen weight/clearance fields, supporting source and research-attempt records, and dated batch documentation.
